versions.subject: Merge PR #4961 from @tsale - Add multiples rules and updates
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '[System/EventID='
        - '/create'
        - '/delete'
        - '/ec'
        - '/so'
        - '/tn run'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\powershell.exe") CommandLine="*[System/EventID=*" CommandLine="*/create*" CommandLine="*/delete*" CommandLine="*/ec*" CommandLine="*/so*" CommandLine="*/tn run*"
